caption: The drawing depicts a vessel with two large, vertically-oriented handles on either side and a wide, open top. The main body of the vessel is cylindrical, tapering slightly toward the base, and appears to have a textured or mottled surface. The vessel stands on three short, curved legs that elevate it above the ground. The two handles are attached symmetrically, each being elongated and rounded, with a subtle horizontal groove near their middle. The drawing is executed in shades of gray and black, suggesting the use of pencil or charcoal on a beige or slightly yellowed background. A thin rectangular border frames the image, and the name "Mildred Ford" is written in small letters at the bottom left corner.
title: Ember Carrier
